decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the firm's established automation offering, it likely has low enough continuation cost and enough remaining uncertainty that management would keep this option open for another year.
The web-based dimensioning tool fits the firm's engineering and planner customer base, is probably inexpensive to maintain, and has not been in the market long enough to justify abandonment.

Although a full fouling detection system is likely more resource-intensive to support than a software tool, it aligns well with the firm's infrastructure efficiency strategy and is still too new for management to close the option.
